name: Gold trend-following (TSMOM on gold)

why_dead: Secular-bull-beta in a TSMOM costume — the MC random-entry null BEATS it; 26y daily net-NEGATIVE; loses the decisive 2011-15 bear. A random long-biased entry already earns gold's drift, so trend rules add nothing.
kill_metric: MC random-entry null beats it; 26y net-NEGATIVE; loses 2011-15 bear
revive_condition: A non-price trend confirmation on an independent channel that de-betas gold's secular drift, or a trend test on an instrument without a 25y secular uptrend.

name: B1 COT positioning-extreme contrarian
what_tested: 156wk-percentile COT noncomm net positioning, fade extremes, 6 instruments, +1wk lag.
why_dead: Generalizes to NONE: only silver clears the MC-null but fails OOS-Sharpe>0.3; the short leg fights the secular bull; pooled is noise.
kill_metric: best MC-p 0.011 (silver only); 0/6 generalize; pooled Sharpe 0.014
revive_condition: A disaggregated/managed-money positioning panel with a true point-in-time vintage archive, or an intraday positioning proxy.

kill_metric: XAU MC-null p=0.059 (FAIL); 2011-15 bear -39.5/-127.9bps XAU/XAG
revive_condition: A regime-conditioned real-rate state that genuinely de-betas the secular gold drift AND beats both base and complement at shuffle-null p<0.05 (Stream 6 gold_regime_state).

name: B3 GVZ gold implied-vol reversion
what_tested: Gold implied-vol (CBOE GVZ) 252d z-score, fade ±2σ (the crypto-DVOL analog on gold).

revive_condition: An OTC option-skew / 25Δ risk-reversal series (paywalled) rather than ATM GVZ, or a non-directional vol-sizing target.

what_tested: SPDR GLD ounces-in-trust 60d flow z-score / flow-vs-price divergence (stablecoin analog).
why_dead: Gold ETF flow LAGS price; no defensive value in the bear; silver negative, pooled negative. Worst sleeve in the book (LOO-Δ-Sharpe -0.014).

revive_condition: A stablecoin/flow signal mapped onto genuinely DISTINCT FX risk channels, or an intraday alignment where dry-powder actually leads an FX session open.

kill_metric: shuffle-label p=0.42; complement > in-band set
revive_condition: A regime variable with a true independent channel applied to a base that ALREADY has standalone edge (conditioning arbitrates surviving alpha; it cannot create it).

revive_condition: A genuinely NEW orthogonal feature carrying directional info absent from the 8-feature zoo (intraday CME order-flow, OTC skew, COMEX inventory, a real (actual,forecast) panel). Re-running ML over the same exhausted features is forbidden.

name: Combined FX book-of-4 under MC-null-first hierarchy

kill_metric: DSR 0.483<0.5; dovish leg = beta; rates MC-p 0.144; lexicon MC-p 0.085
revive_condition: A tone signal that (a) replicates under a frozen pre-sample lexicon (no LLM look-ahead), (b) is two-sided not easing-regime beta, and (c) carries a 2nd distinct channel (rates, not just price).

name: S8 regime conditioning of funding_squeeze (HMM/BOCPD)
what_tested: Conditioning/sizing the live funding_squeeze sleeve on a causal HMM/BOCPD/vol-bucket regime state.
why_dead: No gate beats the shuffle-null: best HMM-trend conditioning shuffle-p≈0.11 (right sign but underpowered); the regime state does not provably beat trivial efficiency-ratio. Regime-aware CPCV = KILL (split perm-p 0.135 = noise → keep standard CPCV). The state ships as an S8 input only.
kill_metric: best conditioning shuffle-p≈0.11; regime-aware CPCV perm-p 0.135 (noise)
revive_condition: A base sleeve with standalone edge to condition (conditioning arbitrates surviving alpha, it cannot create it) and a regime gate that beats the shuffle-null p<0.05 on enough trades.

name: S2.2A funding cross-sectional continuation (XS)
what_tested: Daily cross-sectional funding-z reshuffle, LONG high-funding / SHORT low-funding (continuation), tercile two-leg market-neutral.
why_dead: WRONG-WAY SIGN — cross-sectional funding MEAN-REVERTS, it does not continue (gross-only ann Sharpe -1.38). Even with the sign flipped it is COST-KILLED: the two-leg honest cost is -16.85 bps/day because a daily funding-z reshuffle turns over ~100%/day. gross(price) -8.7 · carry -1.45 · cost -16.85 bps. MC random-sign p=1.0 (sign wrong-way).
kill_metric: gross_ann_sharpe -1.38 (wrong-way); cost -16.85 bps/day; ~100%/day rotation; MC-sign p=1.0
revive_condition: A funding signal whose forward sign is STABLE (not mean-reverting) and that survives the ~100%/day two-leg cost — e.g. a slow, low-turnover funding state, NOT a daily XS reshuffle.

name: S2.2D volatility-dispersion cross-sectional (XS)

revive_condition: A vol-dispersion signal with a significant gross edge (MC-sign p<0.05) large enough to survive cost — the faint +0.20 whiff is not it.

what_tested: Cross-venue funding dispersion sleeve, 5 coins × 4 venues (Binance/OKX/Bybit/Bitget), 1d.

kill_metric: ann Sharpe -0.44 (wrong-sign); MC-sign p=0.05; thin 5-coin universe
revive_condition: A cross-venue crowding signal with a stable forward sign on a wider venue×coin panel — the 5-coin dispersion is exhausted (data now exists; the edge does not).

name: Global-LSR (all-accounts) contrarian positioning
what_tested: Retail-aggregate long-short-ratio (CoinGlass global_account_long_short_ratio) as a SYMMETRIC contrarian directional sleeve on BTC/ETH/SOL/AVAX 1d: z-score 180-bar trailing (ddof=0), |z|>=2 threshold, hold 2 bars, entry lag 1, 15bps RT taker cost. Appendix ARB/SUI/WIF non-decisive.
why_dead: Date-level de-overlapped basket (4 decisive symbols, event_basket_gate, no_overlap=True) fails BOTH binding criteria simultaneously: MC random-entry null p in [0.1155, 0.1415] across 5 seeds (all >= 0.05, stable but wrong side of the bar) AND OOS-by-date Sharpe = -0.1472 (<=0) across all 5 seeds. DSR against the post-bump crypto-book trial count (N=1909) collapses to ~2.5e-05 (PSR vs zero itself only 0.52, i.e. coin-flip). Not a momentum-redux (max |rho| z-vs-momentum30d = 0.337, BTC, well under the 0.7 kill line) and orthogonal to S2 funding_squeeze on a weekly grid (rho=-0.096, well under 0.30) — so this is a genuine null result, not a redux or a duplicate of an existing pillar. 2022 bear coverage is technically non-zero (events exist on all 4 decisive symbols) but structurally thin on BTC/SOL (n=1 each), consistent with the retail ratio rarely reaching |z|>=2 during a generalized panic where the crowd is already uniformly short.
kill_metric: basket mc_p >= 0.05 (5 seeds, 0.1155-0.1415) AND OOS-by-date <= 0 (-0.1472, 5 seeds); DSR vs N=1909 ~= 2.5e-05
revive_condition: A genuinely new data axis (e.g., cross-venue global-LSR divergence, or a sub-daily cadence with a lake that supports it) with its own fresh pre-registration under the hardened bar. NEVER re-run the same 180/2.0/2-bar/1d form on this instrument set — it is exhausted.

what_tested: Imbalance quotidien = (taker_buy_usd - taker_sell_usd)/(taker_buy_usd + taker_sell_usd), source coinglass taker_volume perp (Binance-aggregated), z-score trailing 180x1d ddof=0, |z|>=2 CONTINUATION symetrique (z>=+2 LONG, z<=-2 SHORT), hold 2x1d, lag1 causal, 15bps RT, univers decisif BTC/ETH/SOL/AVAX + annexe ARB/SUI/WIF, panier date-level dedup event_basket_gate.

Le cote CONTRARIAN reste techniquement non teste (interdit par ce PREREG, pas un revive_condition -- necessiterait son PROPRE pre-enregistrement independant, pas une reouverture de cette entree).

name: FX London-session channel breakout (tier-2 survivor)
what_tested: Breakout de canal 1h N40 à l'ouverture de Londres, hold H12, sur USDCHF/USDJPY/EURJPY (le dernier survivant tier-2 de la campagne breakout FX).

Confirme sur FX le verdict crypto (#15/#24) : les familles breakout OHLCV single-asset meurent net de coût honnête = whipsaw.

name: S2 funding-squeeze BREADTH (universe expansion beyond the validated basket)
what_tested: Élargir la règle S2 GELÉE (z>=2, fenêtre 180, hold 24x4h) du panier validé (BTC/ETH/SOL + SUI/ARB/WIF/AVAX) à un univers plus large de perps Binance USDT-M liquides, pour multiplier le DÉBIT d'événements (~13/an) sans toucher à la règle. Deux essais comptés : s2_breadth_prereg (survivants seuls) et s2_breadth_hardened_prereg (univers point-in-time INCLUANT les délistés, la seule suite autorisée par le verdict du 2026-07-02).
why_dead: Les DEUX essais échouent à la lettre de leur propre pré-enregistrement, sur des critères INDÉPENDANTS. Essai 1 (survivants, 12 perps) : +75.8 % d'événements marginaux et joint-null p_max5=0.003, MAIS la fenêtre bear 2024-07→09 (n=4) est négative — zéro tolérance. Essai 2 (durci, 12+4 morts qualifiés sur 131 candidats testés) : les événements marginaux tombent à +15.0 % (seuil +50 %) ET la même fenêtre bear reste négative (-622.8 bps, n=4). Le durcissement MESURE enfin le biais de survie soupçonné par l'audit et le CONFIRME : l'inclusion des morts fait tomber l'edge de +270.3 -> +236.6 bps/évt (-12.5 %), le Sharpe de 0.304 -> 0.273 et l'OOS-by-date de 0.316 -> 0.245 (-23 %) — le chiffre publié sur les survivants était bien gonflé. DSR au N réel du registre (1911) = 0.00027. Réserve STRUCTURELLE et non résoluble : ZÉRO événement z>=2 en 2022 sur l'univers durci (les 4 morts qualifiés n'entrent qu'en 2023-2024) — le bear-check est aveugle au cœur d'un crash, S2 étant un phénomène de rebond, pas de chute.

name: Illiquid-tail / balance-sheet carry (Boucle β) — vendre du bilan sur la queue ou en vault
what_tested: La thèse « le petit va où les fonds ne peuvent pas » : récolter le funding/basis delta-neutre sur les perps ILLIQUIDES de la queue (là où le capital de bilan institutionnel type Ethena ne se déploie pas), son steelman bi-directionnel (reverse-carry : long perp / short spot pour encaisser la magnitude du funding négatif de la queue), et sa variante passive (déposer dans un vault contrepartie-des-traders type HLP comme position du MOTEUR).
why_dead: RÉFUTÉ dans les trois directions, par mesure (research_streams/BETA, 3 red-teams unanimes). (1) Le SIGNE tue la thèse : pente forward 2025+ funding~liquidité = +0.047 (t=+2.72), POSITIVE — la récolte monte AVEC la liquidité, l'inverse exact de la thèse ; queue Binance médiane −2.3 %, moyenne −10.8 % (33 % positifs) ; exo Hyperliquid moyenne −10.7 %. La magnitude 2-3× de la queue est réelle mais NÉGATIVE-signée = territoire reverse-carry. (2) Le reverse-carry est borrow-locké : +15 % brut forward, mais le funding négatif EST le coût de borrow d'un token hard-to-borrow (no-arb) ; au borrow honnête λ=1.0 → −1.9 %, 0 % des marchés positifs — le lake ne voit pas le borrow, le chiffre brut est non-revendicable. (3) Le vault-dépôt (HLP ~15-30 % APR) est un profil short-vol avec pertes adversariales documentées (JELLY 2025-03-26 : −$12-13.5M latents, sauvés par un delisting discrétionnaire) : c'est une DÉCISION D'ALLOCATION OPÉRATEUR, jamais une position du moteur. La persistance du mécanisme joue CONTRE nous : plus le bilan institutionnel croît, plus le plancher colle.

Les vaults restent des décisions d'allocation opérateur, hors moteur.
